cad_use.footprint: example-minimal-circuit-lib:SOIC-8_3.9x4.9mm_P1.27mm (chosen explicitly; the symbol's default Footprint property Package_SO:SO-8_3.9x4.9mm_P1.27mm is not used)

performed: Pins: SDA 1 (bidirectional), SCL 2 (input), ALERT 3 (open_collector), GND 4 (power_in), A2 5, A1 6, A0 7 (input), V+ 8 (power_in); matches Table 5-1

Default Footprint property is Package_SO:SO-8_3.9x4.9mm_P1.27mm, an NXP PCF8523-derived pattern (pads 1.75 x 0.6 mm at x = +/-2.575 mm); the project uses SOIC-8_3.9x4.9mm_P1.27mm instead so that footprint and 3D model come from one JEDEC MS-012AA package family (fact-tmp1075-footprint-choice). The symbol's ki_fp_filters 'SO*3.9x4.9mm*P1.27mm*' accepts both
